notes: @MastercardDevelopers does not exist on YouTube (404 under three handle variants); developer content lives on @MastercardNews ('APIs in 60 Seconds', 'API for Everything', US Open Banking tutorials), on the 'Mastercard Merchant Cloud' channel (MPGS gateway tutorials) and on 'Mastercard Open Finance' (Finicity demos). Nothing official was found on YouTube for Mastercard Connect, Mastercom, Engage (beyond one overview), the MCP server, or Maestro/Cirrus (all Maestro/Cirrus hits were logo animations and consumer explainers - dropped). The session's WebSearch budget was already exhausted (200/200) before this task started, so vimeo, conference archives, decks, PDFs, app-store listings and court exhibits were NOT searched; developer.mastercard.com is a client-rendered app and returned no content to WebFetch; mastercardconnect.com returns a browser-gate page; the mastercard.com Mastercom page returned 403. dropped_count is an estimate: roughly 740 rows reviewed across two channel listings (400) and 17 searches (340), minus 52 kept and a few duplicates; drops were dominated by consumer campaigns (Priceless, Messi, Touch Card, cashback), scam-awareness series, inclusive-growth summit sessions, cardholder login how-tos, crypto commentary, and Maestro/Cirrus logo videos. Duration/views are null for @Mastercard channel items because the flat channel listing does not return them.
